_doc: Human-reviewed product type definitions. A request for a type listed here is retrieved with these deterministic rules (category codes, include terms, excluded subtypes). Any other product ('other') is retrieved generically: catalogue word search, then Claude classifies every candidate (is the product / variant / contains it / different product), and the order always needs a person (guardrail 'product type reviewed by a person'). To let a new type order autonomously, add it here, generate its review sheet with `python3 review_product_type.py TYPE` and sign it with `--sign TYPE --by NAME` (sets reviewed, reviewed_by, reviewed_at and review_sheet_sha256). milk still carries the placeholder reviewer 'demo team' and no signed sheet. Fields: label, measure (L, KG or PCS), density_kg_per_l (for CO2e of liquids), categories, include (name terms; a product must contain one), exclude (name term -> reason), request (buyer words per language, used by the rule parser), note.

milk.label: milk

exclude.piimä: sour milk (piimä) is not drinking milk
exclude.sour milk: sour milk is not drinking milk
exclude.kahvi: coffee milk / coffee drink, not plain milk

milk.note: Category 10400 = milk & milk drinks, inferred from the data (category names are not in the data set).
